name: The Blue Lizard Effect
summary: Jason Silva embarks on a journey to Aruba, "the happiest island in the world," in search of his true happiness.

name: Show Me Show Me
summary: Join Chris, Pui and the toys in their magical playroom. Have fun playing games, singing songs and practising your groovy moves.

name: Show Me Show Me Seaside
summary: Celebrate summer and brighten your morning with some very special mini-episodes of Show Me Show Me. Chris, Pui and all the toys head to Scarborough where they have lots of fun at the seaside. There's the usual mix of songs, nursery rhymes and imaginative play to explore rockpools, sandcastles, ice-cream - and more.

name: A League of Their Own: Mexican Road Trip
summary:
A League of Their Own is heading to Mexico for their next epic adventure. As ever, it's Red vs Blue –with the teams competing in a series of sporting and cultural challenges in a bid to avoid the series forfeit.

To raise the stakes, for the first time ever it won't just be the team captains in the firing line for the forfeit.

In previous series, viewers have seen the gang dance as cheerleaders in front of 90,000 LA Rams fans, taken driving lessons from Max Verstappen at the Singapore Grand Prix, had a tennis match umpired by Novak Djokovic at the Monte-Carlo Masters and joined the cast of Aladdin on Broadway.

This Road Trip promises to be even more exciting as the teams travel from Mexico City to Baja California – seeing all incredible Mexico has to offer.

Among the adventures is taking part in the infamous Day of the Dead Parade, learning the art of Mexican Rodeo, scuba diving with sea lions in choppy waters, and wrestling each other in a Lucha Libre match.

Anything for some points for the team, right?

previousepisode.name: An unexpected Best Actor emerged on the field

name: The Traitors. Zdrajcy
summary: Participants come to a dark castle to fight for a cash prize. The entire team is divided into "Loyals" and "Traitors", who are selected by Malwina on the first day of the game. The main goal of the villains is to eliminate the other group and divide the reward among themselves. Every night, the Traitors meet for a joint debate to determine who from the Loyal group will be eliminated. All participants also take part in challenging missions.

name: Wo Zai Dong Bei Zuo Bai Shi De Na Xie Nian
summary: Chu Sheng followed Master Qin in the northeast to do funeral business, for all kinds of dead people. During that, there were many strange funeral anecdotes. As a professional undertaker, Chu Sheng visited the folk together with the Reporter Lin who came to explore the weird stories and experienced one after another bizarre folk stories.

name: House of the Owl
summary: At the heigh of his career and powers, Japan's master fixer, who has guided politicians and business heads through some of Japan's biggest scandals and triumphs, must maneuver through his last and biggest fix. Meanwhile, he must come to grips with the problems that besiege his own familiy as he discovers that fixing his family is sometimes harder than fixing a country.

name: The Love Duel
summary: The cool woman has to play a maid who has always been humiliated while the gentle CEO has to pretend like he's a brutal prince. She sharpens her dagger every night, trying crazily to kill him; He teases her every day, trying desperately to win her heart. In this amusing and romantic love duel, let's see who can gain ground and complete the mission first. During the duel, they begin to realize that they're caught in a conspiracy.

name: Dare to Love Me
summary: A full-fledged defense romantic comedy about Shin Yoon Bok, a pupil from Seongsan village with Confucianism in his bones, and Kim Hong Do, an aggressive modern woman who only knows how to go straight.

name: Bitter Sweet Hell
summary: Bitter Sweet Hell tells the story of Korea's best psychological counselor Young Won and her mother-in-law Sa Gang facing each other's secrets and truths due to their husband and son.

name: DNA Lover
summary: So Jin, a genetic researcher who loves DNA, decides to end her relationship with a playboy boyfriend and sets out to find a genetically compatible partner for a happy relationship. Whom among the two men that So Jin meets, obstetrician-gynecologist Yeon Woo and firefighter Kang Hoon, will be the perfect match for her? A captivating story intertwined with genetics! This story portrays the struggles, love, and everyday lives of young friends.

name: Tokyo Tower
summary: Kojima Toru is a medical school student, but he is bored with his life that always seems the same. One day, he meets an architect, Asano Shifumi, and he is invited to her office. He enjoys a pleasant time with her. They drink coffee and listen to music. At that time, he sees a black and white photo of the Tokyo Tower on her office wall. He asks her if she likes the Tokyo Tower, and she replies that she does not because it looks lonely to her. Kojima Toru loves the time he spends with her. A couple of days later, he visits her office again and tells her that he wants to know more about her.

name: The Dog & Pony Show
summary: A hilarious series about two very different best friends who leave their magical world of Rainbow Fjörd and move to the not-so-magical big city of UniCity.

name: SpacePOP
summary: When the evil Empress Geela takes over the Planets of The Pentangle, the five teenage princesses disguise themselves as musicians and form a band called SpacePOP. Their mission: Spread the message of freedom and joy through

name: Father of the Bride
summary: When the daughter of a prosperous family decides to marry, it's her harried father, who ends up suffering most.

name: Wicked!
summary: Two teenagers Rory and Dawn are stalked by a doll with a head shaped like an eaten apple which Rory got from his dead father. The doll become alive and try to murder and terrorize the two teenagers and everyone around them.

name: The Express Way with Dulé Hill
summary: The Express Way with Dulé Hill is a premium documentary series that transcends geographical boundaries, providing viewers with an intimate look into the lives of artists across America. Each episode serves as a bridge, connecting diverse backgrounds and celebrating the universal power of the arts to illuminate the human experience. The journey begins in California, a state synonymous with dreams, where Dulé uncovers a narrative beyond the surface.

name: Трудная
summary: One mistake of youth - and years of attempts to correct it. Since childhood, Vlada has been inconvenient for those around her: difficult, distrustful, aggressive. Having stumbled once, the girl has served her sentence and wants to start a new life. Max helps her in this, having already gone through hell in New Girl. But the past again pulls Vlada to the bottom. And this time, on the path to freedom, you need to overcome not only yourself.

name: Camden
summary: Set in London's beating heart of music "Camden" reveals the untold stories of how the lives and careers of some of the world's most iconic artists were influenced by this corner of London. Through archive footage, observational filming and interviews, we will explore Camden's rich history. Hearing from world renowned musicians as they relive their Camden experiences; from their very first gigs to sell out concerts, the highs and lows of nights out and a youth spent discovering music.

name: Mastermind: To Think Like a Killer
summary: Mastermind: To Think Like a Killer, a fascinating new perspective on the woman whose crime hunting innovations changed history. To stop serial killers, psychiatric nurse and professor Dr. Ann Burgess must first learn to think like one. With unprecedented access to the mastermind behind the development of modern serial-killer profiling, the series tells Burgess' tenacious story and her compassion for victims which puts her at the center of America's most infamous true-crime cases. From the widely known Ed Kemper and Ted Bundy to lesser-known cases like the Ski Mask Rapist, Burgess investigates and studies the damaged psyches of victims and their attackers, putting two halves of the same story together to catch a killer. Largely an unsung heroine until now, Dr. Burgess impacted not only the FBI, she also radically championed the plight of women in America.

name: Failure Frame: I Became the Strongest and Annihilated Everything with Low-Level Spells
summary: Touka Mimori and his classmates are abruptly catapulted into a fantasy world, summoned by the resident goddess to serve as heroes. The good news? Most of the students display amazing skills upon arrival! The bad? Mimori is the worst of the lot, bottoming out at a measly E-rank. Incensed, the goddess tosses him into a dungeon to die–but it turns out that Mimori's skills aren't so much worthless as they are abnormal. Abnormally powerful, perhaps!

name: Life on the Water
summary: Following the on-the-water lifestyle, including fishing, travel, food, cruising, diving and other activities as seen through the eyes of Capt. Brandon Simmons.

previousepisode.name: The Magic of Malta: Part One
History of Broadcast Innovations and Technology

name: Real Sex
summary: Real Sex explores human sexuality, from the latest sexual fads to casual sex festivals and home production of pornographic movies. The show typically explores three to four topics each episode. Segments are separated by street interviews with random people, relating to the episode's topics.

previousepisode.name: Real Sex 33: Stocks Down, Sex Up

name: Чудо-люди
summary: In the sensational project "Miracle People," the famous Safronov brothers defy the laws of physics and nature to amaze viewers with incredible and dangerous stunts performed to the limit of human capabilities.

name: В кругу друзей
summary:
Famous guests come to the studio with their kind and sweet pets and talk about what surprises their four-legged and feathered family members give them every day.

Viewers can expect exclusive video reports and advice from experts - groomers, zoologists, hippotherapists, dog trainers, animal psychologists, lawyers and even animal fashion experts. Also, TV viewers will have the opportunity to shelter a pet left without an owner.

name: Garouden: The Way of the Lone Wolf
summary: In this gritty martial arts anime, a fugitive seeking redemption is forced to compete in an illegal martial arts tournament.

name: Bpom Ruk Roy Adeed
summary: Tawan Chai rushes back to Thailand from England after hearing that his grandfather and uncle have passed away in an accident. Tawan Chai believes he is the only living heir to his family fortune. After his uncle and grandfather's funeral and the reading of the will, however, Tawan Chai is surprised to discover that he is not the only heir and he might have to share his inheritance with Torfun, who is believed to be a long lost grandchild. Torfun is a street smart young woman with a heart of gold who needs the money to support her family and pay hers and her little brother's school tutitions. Tawan Chai is not too happy about Torfun and her family moving into his mansion and even though they try to act like cousins, destiny just won't let them...

name: Maya
summary: The story of Pitawan (Usamanee Vaithayanon), a young woman under the guardianship of Inthanil (Duangdao Jarujinda), a wealthy woman who adopted her. But because you never gave love and also oppressed to be inferior Makes Pitawan yearn for a perfect life.

name: Dok Fah Ya Jai
summary: Kornpakamarasri, or Paka, is the daughter of Mr. Tinnakorn and Mrs. Saiyud, owners of Morakot Property Company, a famous real estate company. She had a nanny named Nim, who raised her to be a good person. After studying abroad, Paka came back home but didn't do any work because her family was rich. Later, her family's company started doing badly. Tinnakorn was stressed and working very hard. One day, he fell and died due to a blood vessel in his brain. Saiyud then let the subordinates help manage the work. As for herself, she became a gambling addict until she lost everything except for the company and some land. Tinnapan, a new millionaire, agrees to gamble with Saiyud because of her daughter's beauty. Saiyud lost and therefore had to transfer the company and the land to Tinnapan, but on the day of the transfer, he made an offer to marry Paka, and then he would return everything. Saiyud tries to persuade Paka to marry Tinnapan, but she refuses. Saiyud and Paka end up moving to a small, old, wooden house. Paka had a hard time adjusting and likes to look down on others, especially poor people. Meanwhile, Tinnapan always tries to help Paka without her knowing. Will his love eventually reach her heart?

previousepisode.name: Snuiven, opstootjes en een bloedig eind

name: Dance-A-Lot Robot
summary: Dance-A-Lot, a robot with rhythm, teaches preschoolers simple original dance steps.

name: Tasty Time with ZeFronk
summary: A French Dachshund called ZeFronk hosts a healthy cooking show from his doghouse with his assistant, a songbird named Sue, and his silly neighbour cat named Dom that always sneaks away the snacks that ZeFronk makes, and each episode ends with ZeFronk chasing Dom around the prep counter, triggering Sue to fly away and come through the iris wipe.

name: Can You Teach My Alligator Manners?
summary: A young boy named Mikey has a pet alligator named Al, and Mikey's mother says Mikey can't keep Al unless Al learns manners. Mikey enlists the help of the audience to teach Al manners in a variety of places and situations.

name: Mama Mirabelle's Home Movies
summary: Programme for pre-school children combining animation with live action footage from National Geographic and the BBC film archives.

previousepisode.name: Kings and Queens of the Savannah

name: Inside Windsor Castle
summary: For the Royal Family, Windsor Castle is simply home: a place to take time out and relax. But what actually goes on behind the castle walls? In this series Xand Van Tulleken, JJ Chalmers and Raksha Dave reveal decades of royal drama and uncover how the building itself has changed and adapted with the times.

name: Sue Perkins: Lost in Thailand
summary:
Sue Perkins makes a triumphant return to Channel 5 with an incredible brand-new three-part series. Heading off the beaten track, Sue explores three regions of Thailand, meeting extraordinary people – and animals!

First, she heads north to Chiang Mai, kicking off her journey by abseiling from the wonderfully named Crazy Horse Buttress into a limestone cave deep underground. Next, on the island of Phuket she helps to clear detritus from a coral reef: 'litter picking does not get any better than this!' In Bangkok she pops into a Buddhist Hell Garden to explore the potential wages of sin, has a driving lesson on an electric tuk-tuk in a monsoon and picks the world's most aromatic coconut with secateurs 20 feet above her head. Not scary at all.

As she travels across Thailand she meets extraordinary animals too. Sue learns to sing lullabies to recovering elephants and discovers the secrets of a gibbon ‘love tunnel'. Throughout this vibrantly colourful and joyful meander through unseen Thailand, Sue Perkins is funny, fresh and empathetic, happily losing herself in Thailand.

name: Cumbria: The Lakes and the Coast
summary:
Showcasing the beauty and charm of Cumbria, this new observational documentary series follows some of the hardy residents who live and work in this ceremonial county, exploring the magic of the Lake District National Park and delving into the beauty of its dramatic coastline.

Filmed across Summer 2023, the series celebrates old traditions and welcomes new life, with unique access to historic castles and ancient gardens, as well as a range of characters from steamboat operators to wild swimmers, local potters to gin distillers, a lobster fishing couple to divers uncovering history from the bed of Lake Windermere.

name: Tut's Toxic Tomb
summary: The discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb became overshadowed by a Pharaoh's Curse. Now can modern science explain the truth behind this epic legend?

name: Dinner Time Live with David Chang
summary: Chef David Chang hosts an unfiltered dining experience as he cooks for celebrity guests and shares culinary secrets.

name: Quarter Ton Teen
summary: Quarter Ton Teen follows teenagers struggling with severe obesity on a multi-year journey as they fight for healthier lives. Knowing they face uncertain futures unless they lose weight, these teens pursue weight-loss surgery in hopes of a second chance. Told in part with their own personal footage, the series documents their determination for a better life and the challenging journey to get healthy that will test them in ways they don't expect.

name: Смех без правил
summary: This is a real fight between those who feel the talent of a comedian, improvise well and dream of performing on stage. Instead of sharpened swords, there is wit, and instead of steel muscles, the participants use artistry. These fighters are not professionals yet, but they have the main thing - the desire to make the audience laugh and the thirst for victory.

name: Убойная лига
summary: A real comedy battle among the most desperate comedians. There is stand-up, improvisation and jokes on the edge and beyond.

name: Brennpunkt: Instukids
summary: They came for help, but became drug addicts. Children and young people tell about short routes to pills and syringes in Norwegian child welfare institutions.

name: Убойной ночи
summary: News is discussed here because it is the most fertile environment for jokes. The participants of the comedy show, masters of improvisational humor, laugh only at current events that worry people and occupy the first lines in blogs. The topic of the program could be the launch of the hadron collider, the permission of cloning in Australia, or the election results in the United States.

name: Убойный вечер
summary: A humorous debate in which two teams defend their polar points of view on a certain topic. As a rule, current news or an event becomes the reason for discussion. The basis of the format is the classic panel comedy game, decorated with improvisations.

name: Hell on Earth: WWII
summary: Explores the story of The Second World War, beginning when the war become global and ending with the aftermath.

name: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
summary: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer takes back the narrative of their lives by sharing disturbing yet empowering accounts of how they escaped the clutches of a serial killer.

name: Talking Sabor
summary: Renowned Mexican-American chef Aarón Sánchez travels to Los Angeles, Houston, Miami and New York to celebrate Latin restaurants with authentic flavors. On each episode, a celebrity guest joins him on this gastronomic adventure to cook up culture, share stories, and create a menu together.

name: Hilarious Family 2
summary: Ai Shiqi, a stay-at-home innkeeper who insists on being a "desert" woman, has become a "single typical" of the government crackdown after an outrageous legal battle. Thanks to Ezekiel, Genkan was forced to marry Ezekiel to help her get out of trouble. The "little couple," who thought they could split up after marriage, became embroiled in a leadership feud at the local tea house. Under the eaves of the family's house, there were strange rooms: Wei Junyi, an old grandmother who was Buddhist on the surface and a mirror on the inside. Luo Su-se, the fierce and ruthless mother of Jenkan, the self-possessed and spoiled sister of Jen Pearl, Lu Jiao, a maid whose vanity serves as a sword of mouth, Luo Aiji, an unworthy brother whose arrogance leaves no one behind, and Lin Dong-lin, a sleek and worldly husband-in-law. In the face of all kinds of difficulties, Ai Jie and the Scriptures exhausted their thoughts, and when he tried to give up several times, he found the meaning of "home" in the difficult scripture.

name: Baalveer
summary: Ballu is taken to a fairyland where he is blessed with special powers by six fairies, each having her own unique traits. He uses his powers to help good and honest children, including his friends.

name: Flower in the Mirror
summary: During the Republic of China, Du Lanruo, the daughter of a wealthy family in Yangcheng, suffered an accidental amnesia when she was young, resulting in a loss of identity. Later, he was adopted by Erhu artist Lao Ma, who changed his name to Ma Qingqing. He and his senior brother Shui Sheng, the three masters and apprentices shuttled around performing arts in teahouses and making a living as a waiter. Her only hobby is acting and she has amazing acting talent. Qingqing's biggest dream is to become a popular star like Du Lanruo.

name: Family Aaj Kal
summary: The Kashyaps like to believe they are an open-minded lot that respects everybody's work. But when their daughter falls in love with a cab driver, can they overcome their biases and accept her choice of partner?

name: Leap Day
summary: February 29, also known as Leap Day, comes around once every four years and is a cause for celebration. That is true for a lot of people, except for Day and Night. Every February 29, on their birthday, someone they love dies. But the year they turn 20, Day's cousin Ozone and Night's closest friend Dream survive the fateful curse. Day and Night must now work together to defeat their Leap Day destiny. Will this mystery be unraveled?

name: The Heart Killers
summary:
When hitmen are in love, they put both their lives and hearts at risk. Now only one question needs to be answered: is it to kiss… or to kill? 


Kant, a badass tattooist police informant, is asked to investigate a hitman brother duo. But when his attempt to dig up information by getting close to the younger brother, Bison, gets curbed by the overprotective big brother Fadel, Kant has no choice but to find someone to take Fadel out of the way. That's where Style, his good-looking foolhardy mechanic friend, comes in. Now the two friends are putting their lives, and hearts, on the line.

name: Friendshit Forever
summary:
"You're like a sister to me. You're my best friend."

Those were the words Baikhaw said to Tulip when they first met—before their worlds would forever change. What begins as a beautiful friendship between two young women unravels into a dangerous web of envy and deceit. Baikhaw hides her jealousy behind a perfect smile, aided by Tao, her devoted high-school friend who's long been in love with her and would do anything for her. On the other side, Tulip finds an alliance in Namo, her caring university friend who always stays by her side and protects her from Baikhaw's sinister schemes. But revenge rarely ends where it begins, and this game of betrayal might just destroy them all. Because sometimes, the most dangerous enemy… is your best friend.

name: Perfect 10 Liners
summary:
Perfect 10 Liners is a group of perfect faces! Arm takes on the role of managing the Engineer Cute Boy page and unknowingly breaks the rules by posting a photo of his peer mentor's mentor Arc, also known as Perfect 10 Ferocious. Meanwhile, Gun has problems sleeping in the dark, but Perfect 10 Mysterious Yotha, Arm's peer mentee, volunteers to be his roommate. Lastly, Perfect 10 Piteous Wine is a peer mentee of Yotha who has no time to take care of him, so Yotha's younger brother Faifa steps in instead!

How will the relationships and romances between the three Engineering student couples of the Perfect 10 Liners unfold?

name: Us
summary: Twenty-year-old Dokrak decides to take a gap year to find herself after finishing high school. She has a part-time job at a coffee shop in the gallery Art & Us. It's here that she crosses paths with twenty-two-year-old dentistry student Pam, who's a regular at the café, to hit the books. As she gets to know Pam, Dokrak develops a crush. When her brother, however, meets Pam, he falls for her at first sight. Kawi turns to Dokrak, asking her to play matchmaker. Because she loves him and wants to see him happy, Dokrak begins coaching him. As time goes on, however, she finds herself unable to ignore her growing feelings for Pam. Before she knows it, she's fully in love, and Pam is Kawi's girlfriend.

name: Hide & Sis
summary:
Chatfah, the youngest sister of the Buppajinda family, has just received the largest share of her father's inheritance and is about to be married. Unfortunately, however, Chatfah falls from the highest floor of a vacation home to her three older sisters' shocked eyes before her body disappears. Her three sisters—Baibua, Chomphu, and Picha—become suspects in her disappearance.

The eldest sister Baibua is composed, wise, and has always sacrificed for her family. The second, Chomphu, is a confident model whose boyfriend Chatfah stole and was engaged to. The third, Putpichaya, is a jewellery designer and the closest to Chatfah. The three search for Chatfah while further tragedy befalls them following their youngest sister's disappearance.

When no one else can be trusted, the three sisters must try to trust one another. They move back to their childhood mansion to find out who was behind Chatfah's disappearance, which could very well be one of them.

name: Thame - Po Heart That Skips a Beat
summary:
Po has just been dumped by Earn, his boyfriend, because Po is not as successful as him. Po swore to himself that he would never meet someone like Earn again. However, working as a documentary director led him to meet Thame, the leader of the number one idol group MARS, who was about to leave his bandmates to succeed alone in Korea. The group had to disband, and Po branded Thame as no different from Earn.

However, the more Po got to know Thame as a human being, and not an "idol," the more he realized that Thame was not the person he thought. Po wants to help Thame get his friends back, whether it's Nano, Jun, Dylan, or Pepper. Along the way to save MARS, Po accidentally falls in love with Thame, even though he knows that idols can't fall in love... and this feeling may be an obstacle for the group. But what if Thame also wants to love Po? If he doesn't care about those rules and loves Po, will the world collapse?

name: Break Up Service
summary: After Boss and Jued go through love failures, Boss suggests Jued that she come to work at Break Up Service, a company that specializes in breaking up couples. Initially, they dislike each other, as they each played a role in the other's past breakups. However, as Jued proves her skills through hard work, Boss eventually acknowledges her competence. She begins to enjoy her job, relishing the role of a manipulator in relationships—destroying others' romances becomes her way of venting her frustration over her own failed love life. As they continue working together, Boss realizes he is falling for Jued. But Jued doesn't share his feelings. What will happen to their partnership and their mission to break up other couples?

name: Sweet Tooth, Good Dentist
summary: Sant, a university student who has an unwavering love for sweets experiences the heartbreak of his life when he discovers he has a cavity! This forces him to seek treatment from Jay, a handsome dentist, who likes to act cool with a quirky personality. Starting as a tense, oil-and-water relationship, as Sant continues treatment, he begins to wonder whether Jay's caring nature is just part of the job or if there's something more beneath the surface.

name: The Dark Dice
summary:
When the dice hits the ground, that's when the game begins. In this game, you have to fight. In this game, you must betray to survive. Because in this game…

Your life is at stake. If you're ready to play the game, welcome to The Dark Dice.

name: The Ex-Morning
summary:
The Ex-Morning follows two former lovers whose romance ended on a bitter note as they are brought to work together as "exes."

When Padtaphi, a top-tier reporter famously known as "Forecast Prince", loses his temper and throws hot coffee in the face of his junior reporter Tae, whom he doesn't get along with, Padtaphi is severely condemned by the public. His life turns upside down, going from rising star to fallen reporter, and his company immediately suspends Padtaphi and ends his role as a weather reporter to cool things down. Yong, a big producer who's Padtaphi's senior, gives him a chance to develop a fresh news program on the condition that he must work with a new producer, Tamtawan, who holds a degree from abroad and turns out to be Padtaphi's ex!

The two of them face many obstacles while working on the show together, from earning the trust of the crew that hates Padtaphi, to capturing the public's affection, and most importantly, winning each other's hearts. Can old flames reignite? Will this return to working together change them, or will they learn from this change together?

name: Scarlet Heart Thailand
summary: Nabun, a struggling hair stylist, flees to Chiang Mai after losing her job and discovering her boyfriend's betrayal. While at a hot spring, she nearly drowns and is mysteriously saved. When she awakens, she finds herself in the body of Princess Laila, a sickly noblewoman in the ancient Lanna Kingdom. Adapting to her new life, Nabun faces the challenges of survival and love, encountering kind Chao Saen Thep, her sister's fiancé, and the stern Chao Mueang Fah. Her unconventional thoughts captivate those around her, bringing a fresh perspective to the kingdom's old ways.

name: Cut to the Crime
summary:
When a new client comes into James Busby's hair salon, all he knows is their name, never their story. As each powerful episode unfolds, we join him on a gripping journey of discovery as he cuts to the crime.

Featuring hairdresser and host James Busby, well-known for his transformative online hairdressing content, contributors arrive at his salon and sit in the chair, just like in any hairdressers. While they have their hair washed, cut, dried, and styled, James nurtures them through a powerful, revealing and personally rewarding chat that allows them to share their story and the impact on them, their friends, their family and the wider public too. Each contributor opens up to James in an honest chat that's unfiltered, to the point, real and emotional.

name: What We Saw
summary: Step back in time and immerse yourself in history like never before with Bill Whittle. Get ready to experience the pivotal moments that molded America in a whole new way. With captivating historical footage, you'll feel like you're right there in the thick of it all– without the woke filter. Don't just read about history. Live it.

name: The Floor - Csak egy maradhat
summary: In the game show that started in the Netherlands and has already conquered many countries around the world, 49 players enter the country's largest LED game board at the beginning of each week, but only 1 can remain by the end of the week.

name: Ready Steady Go!
summary: One of the UK's first rock/pop music shows, was a must watch for teenagers on a Friday evening. Often featured The Beatles, The Rolling Stones and The Who.

name: The Basil Brush Show
summary: The cheeky glove puppet fox hosts a variety and sketch show format - a procession of comic stooges play straight man and second fiddle to his antics.

name: Ху из Ху
summary: Celebrity guests answer tricky and sometimes provocative questions from the hosts.

name: Ireland in Music
summary: Ireland's finest musicians perform at the most beautiful and iconic places on the island.

name: Ireland's Hidden Treasures
summary: Witness the incredible work behind the scenes in Irish museums as we meet the custodians who devote their craft to preserving Ireland's Hidden Treasures.

name: Kayak Ó Thuaidh
summary: Four-part series that follows two novice kayakers, as they undertake an epic journey along the northern coast of Ireland.

name: Pass It On
summary: Pass It On follows the journeys of three football clubs competing in the top tier of women's football in Ireland throughout the 2023 season.

name: Модный vs Народный
summary: The "Fashionable vs Folk" project is based on a long-standing confrontation between two respected and beloved popular presenters - People's Artist Nadezhda Babkina and the famous Russian fashion expert Vladislav Lisovets. The heroes of the program find themselves in a studio, where they listen to accusations about their appearance from their friends or relatives, after which they first fall into the hands of "folk" stylists Nadezhda Babkina, and then to "fashionable" stylists Vladislav Lisovets.

name: На 10 лет моложе
summary: The project "10 Years Younger" has been successfully running in England since 2004. Today, analogues of the show can be seen in many countries - from New Zealand to the United States of America. Thousands of women around the world have been able to change themselves thanks to this program. Finally, Russian women also have the opportunity to become participants in a grandiose project.

name: The Shelter: Animal SOS
summary: Series following the work of a dedicated squad of care-staff at Ireland's oldest and largest animal welfare charity, the DSPCA.

name: Fallen Idols: Nick and Aaron Carter
summary: Fallen Idols: Nick and Aaron Carter delves into the lives of Nick and Aaron Carter. From their outsized fame in the late 1990s and early 2000s to their headline-making struggles in recent years, the docuseries pulls back the curtain on the fraught dynamic of the Carter family and the dark side of such an abrupt rise to fame. At its core, Fallen Idols explores the accusations of sexual assault against Nick Carter by three women, while also diving into his brother, Aaron Carter's, struggles with mental health and substance abuse - and the rift that occurred after Aaron decided to support his brother's accusers.

name: Love Again
summary: Shen Zhuoran, a retired literature professor, lives a seemingly content life with his children and grandchildren. After the passing of his beloved wife, he embarks on a journey of matchmaking, encouraged by an old friend. Along the way, he meets four very different women: a kind-hearted head nurse who parts ways with him over a property dispute, a scientist who vanishes after her cancer returns, a domineering union director who smothers him emotionally, and a woman who resembles his late wife but makes a difficult request. Each encounter brings Shen Zhuoran not just emotional challenges but also personal growth. His reflections on love and life ripple through the family, quietly shaping those who have stood by his side all along.

name: Ranneeti: Balakot & Beyond
summary: Post the deadly Pulwama attacks, Kashyap and his team strike back with a fitting reply. In the age of hybrid warfare, they must race against time to bring back their captured pilot while also battling Pakistan's lies in global media.

name: Ar y Ffin
summary:
Ar y Ffin follows experienced Magistrate Claire Lewis Jones as she faces personal turmoil while presiding over cases at Newport Magistrates Court. When Ned Humphries, a childhood friend of Beca, Claire's daughter, faces arson charges, Claire's loyalty to her community is put to the test. Matters are made worse when local criminal kingpin Saint Pete appears on the scene. Claire and Saint Pete go back a long way – will her past come back to threaten her present? As she delves deeper into the case, and suspicions grow around her daughter's new bad-boy boyfriend, Sonny Higgins, Claire uncovers a web of criminal activity that could put her and her family at risk.

As the truth emerges and consequences unfold, Claire must confront her own biases and decisions. The lines between right and wrong become blurred, as Claire's maternal instincts clash with her commitment to uphold the truth.

name: STAX: Soulsville U.S.A.
summary: STAX: Soulsville U.S.A. tells the story of an underdog record label comprised of Black and white collaborators who ushered in the groundbreaking, industry-altering soul music of Otis Redding, Isaac Hayes, Booker T. & the M.G.'s, The Staple Singers, Sam & Dave and many others that defined a generation. Driven by instinct and defying the notion that Black artists needed to be "made marketable," the Memphis-based label went from ultimate outsider to one of the most influential producers of Black music – finding its place inside the broader mainstream record industry. Stax became more than a record label; it transformed into a beacon of Black freedom. It is a quintessentially American story of an audacious group of individuals who dared to make their own music on their own terms creating an institution that has continued to help define our culture long after the label itself has gone.

previousepisode.name: Nothing Takes the Place of You

name: Thirst with Shay Mitchell
summary: Shay Mitchell explores the world one drink at a time as she visits exotic locations, samples unique ingredients, and meets expert hosts. On her journey, she encounters the latest drink trends, the best bars, and 8,000 years of sipping history.

name: Martha & Fetisha
summary: Anything can happen when best friends Martha Leivestad and Fetisha Williams meet every week to catch up.

name: Misfeeling
summary: The cold and beautiful Kaolin Flower E Tokio, who after suffering a series of incidents such as bullying and violence, transformed and came back with a gorgeous transformation, started her own road of revenge with a well-thought-out plan, and finally gained inner redemption and love.

name: Moment of Silence
summary: Mai Lingjing, a deaf housewife, seems to have an ideal life: a perfect husband, Wang Shiming, and a sweet bosom friend, Su Xi. However, her seemingly happy life is shattered into pieces when she accidentally regains her hearing. It turns out that her beloved husband has been cheating on her with her best friend, and the two are planning something horrible together. In order to find out what is really going on, Mai Lingjing has to suffer in silence and pretend to be deaf, so that she can get revenge on the two liars when keeping both of them in the dark.

name: Life After Life
summary: Meng You, a young spiritual official with the ability to shake mountains with her tears, accidentally set free Li Bugui before he drank the Carefree Soup. This action caused turmoil in Lingyuan and put Meng You's Granny in danger. To rectify her error and rescue Granny's life, Meng You volunteered to travel to Qingchuan to complete the task of giving Li Bugui the soup. However, upon arrival, Meng You found that Li Bugui had become Qingchuan's top assassin, possessing formidable martial arts skills. To approach Li Bugui and complete her mission, Meng You embarked on a tumultuous journey filled with persuasion and chaos.

name: The Chonga Girls
summary: The Chonga Girls follows two dangerously confident childhood friends, Mimi and Laura, who move from Miami to Hollywood to realize their dream of becoming famous. But, much to their surprise, they find themselves working at the makeup counter for a department store right off the Walk of Fame.

name: Light Beyond the Reed
summary: Ye Sibei's patience, compromise, and avoidance toward her parents' preference for sons over daughters made her husband, Qin Nan, who loved her deeply but was frustrated by her lack of resistance. He is unable to endure it any longer, leading him to file for divorce. However, at this moment, Ye Sibei faces an assault, plunging her into despair. Upon learning the truth, Qin Nan resolutely stays by her side, encouraging her to seek justice through legal means. With the intervention of the judicial system, the criminal is imprisoned, and the truth is revealed. Ye Sibei and Qin Nan support each other, resolve their family conflicts, and embark on a new chapter in life.

name: Doctor Climax
summary: In the 70's, Doctor Nat, a dermato-venereologist who once dreamt of writing adventure novels and becoming a published author, ends up as the columnist behind "The Climax Question" — a space for answering questions everyone wants to ask but dare not. From masturbation and premature ejaculation to foreplay, STDs, and more, the column discusses forbidden subjects while keeping the inquirers' identities anonymous. Through his work on the newspaper column, Doctor Nat grows closer to Linda, the publisher's art department head. Their budding connection threatens to jeopardize not only the doctor's marriage with his perfect wife, Tukta, but also his family's old-money status.

name: The Treacle People
summary: As the story starts, times are hard for The Treacle People. The once great treacle mines of Northern England are running dry and the treacle industry is in trouble. Things look bleak for Professor Baines-Pilling, inventor of the world's first treacle-powered engine and all the others who depend on the sticky stuff for a living. That's until Rosie and Wizzle, the local youngsters, enter the scene. Armed with nothing but a simple treacle-divining stick, can they save the village, or will the Treacle People come to a sticky end?

name: Rise from the Ashes
summary: After unexpectedly reborn, the young girl Cheng Xinian learned the truth about her past life being manipulated and killed. She became allies with Su Jingyuan, who was infiltrating the Cheng family in order to avenge his family's blood feud. They cooperated tacitly, though they occasionally clashed with each other. Entwined with complex emotions of hatred and warmth, they moved forward hand in hand.

name: The Company
summary: Antique shop owner Bi Zhi from the future and modern-day veterinarian Su Beilu form a partnership to embark on a time-traveling quest to recover antiques. Through different eras' customs and traditions, as well as the twists and turns of life, their adventures are gradually revealed through the duo's careful guidance and collaboration. Along the way, they forge friendships that transcend time and space, ultimately facing their respective lives with optimism and hope.

name: Емеля
summary:
Captain Emelin, nicknamed Emelya, as well as his colleagues, captains Vasin and Dolbunov, are engaged in the most complex investigations, and forensic expert Masha Likhacheva helps them in this. Emelya's reputation is so-so, the head of the department, Colonel Khitruk, dislikes him for his independent character and intransigence, but he has to put up with a valuable employee, because he has good disclosure.

Charisma, observation and the ability to think outside the box help Emelya quickly find criminals. And courage and determination, multiplied by strong fists, effectively neutralize them. His partner Vasin helps to find the necessary information from the Network and phones of victims and intruders. Dolbunov turned out to be the main irritant in the team: he is the employee who talks a lot and does not really do anything. He lives strictly according to the horoscope, and if he has a "bad day" according to the forecast, he will never go to detention. Besides work, Emelya has a purely friendly relationship with Masha Likhacheva. In moments of sad reflection, he goes to Masha for advice, who is well versed in both crimes and amorous affairs.

name: The Substitute Love
summary: Tang Xiaoshan, an off-start constable, accidentally becomes the talented lady of Tao Hua City. However, as she is not well-versed in literary and arts, she hopes to get eliminated as soon as possible. However, she meets Ying Chengmo, the most talented scholar of the campus. Thus begins their love journey.

name: Beauty Strategy
summary: The Xuankun Continent used to be reigned by five clans. Six years ago, the five clans had a war where the Human clan defeated the other four and established their dominant position. During the war, Princess Shuoye of the Spirit clan managed to escape but was nowhere to be found. Six years later, she got into the humans' palace, disguised as Lingzhi to find out the truth about the extinction of her clan and rescue her clansmen who were imprisoned by the humans. In the dangerous palace, Lingzhi behaved carefully, played things by ear, and finally approached Mu Xuanjue, the emperor of the humans. As the two of them tested each other, they gradually had feelings. Lingzhi eventually found out the truth. In the end, she and Mu Xuanjue worked together to defeat the villains and achieve the goal that the five clans would live in peace and harmony together.

name: Денискины рассказы
summary:
The boy listens to his grandfather's stories about the times of the USSR and finds himself in the 1950s. A nostalgic comedy series from producer Sarik Andreasyan based on the cycle of famous children's stories by Viktor Dragunsky. The film adaptation was directed by the writer's grandson, Artemy Dragunsky.  

Denis Viktorovich has been living on Karetny for a long time and he always has something to tell. When he is assigned to look after his grandson Denis, his grandfather begins to entertain the six-year-old boy with stories about another era. Their main character is the same age as Denis, who lived in the 1950s in the USSR. The mischievous man was constantly getting into trouble, but he learned lessons from his adventures. Denis, listening to his grandfather, is transported back in time and realizes that he and the boy from the middle of the last century have much more in common than it might seem.

name: Shikanoko Nokonoko Koshitantan
summary: No one knows Torako used to be a delinquent. All of her classmates only know her as the perfect student. But everything changes when Nokotan, a transfer student with antlers, enters her life. Antlers aren't the only thing strange about Nokotan. Her deer nose can sniff out Torako's secret past! Whether it's at school or the zoo, chaos follows this doe-eyed girl's every step. Torako has so many questions! Is Nokotan a deer, a girl, or something in-between?

previousepisode.name: Farewell Nokotan!? Long Live the Deer Club!

name: Action
summary:
Action is the adrenaline-fueled docuseries from 87North, the world-renowned production company of blockbuster filmmakers David Leitch and Kelly McCormick who are the force behind icon action tentpole films such as Bullet Train, Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw, and Atomic Blonde. In this series, their 87North stunt team takes center stage, revealing the captivating stories of ordinary individuals who are drawn to the electrifying world of action sports, martial arts, motocross and more. These daredevils navigate the high-octane, highly skilled, and often perilous world of film stunts, balancing their professional passion with the demands of everyday life. 

In Action, every exhilarating episode reveals the indomitable spirit and camaraderie that binds together this remarkable group of stunt people. Their shared dreams and love for all things action unite them as they carve their names into the annals of Hollywood history. But be prepared for more than just jaw-dropping stunts; delve into their personal lives and witness the sacrifices they make and the challenges they conquer while juggling the most unique day job on the planet.

name: Billy Corgan‘s Adventures in Carnyland
summary: Billy Corgan's Adventures in Carnyland, a new, 8-episode unscripted series streaming only on The CW, drops the curtain for a look at how Corgan balances life as the driving force behind rock icons The Smashing Pumpkins (Pumpkinworld) with work as a wrestling promoter and owner of the National Wrestling Alliance (Carnyland) while being a dedicated father in the midst of planning an epic wedding to his longtime love, Chloé Mendel.

name: ВИА Суперстар!
summary: Eight musical groups whose popularity peaked in the 80s–90s and 2000s will compete for the title of "superstars."

name: Ты — суперстар!
summary: In the music show, 10 legends of Soviet and Russian pop music from the late 80s and early 90s compete for the title of "real superstar." In order to win, artists must overcome 10 competitive stages, in which all their talent and creativity will be demonstrated.

name: Суперстар-2008. Команда мечты
summary: Two teams took part in the show - "Team USSR" and "Team Russia" - 10 participants each.

previousepisode.name: The Not So Nice Mr. Ice [Impossibles]

name: Sins of the South
summary: Sins of the South is a riveting new true crime series that illuminates the drama, the history and the crime stories found below the Mason-Dixon line. With a deliciously delightful Southern inflected narration, each of the 12-hour-long episodes unravel the twists and turns of a real-life murder, highlighting the disturbing crimes of the South and the wickedness that led to it. First-hand accounts from victims' loved ones and law enforcement, archival footage and cinematic recreations bring these sinful stories to life.

previousepisode.name: Code Blue: A Lone Star State Serial Killer

name: Ally Tiancheng Wonderful Accident
summary: Zhen Miao, an eccentric college student pastry chef, unexpectedly broke into the world of script killing and got engaged to Luo Tianjue, a handsome senior who was different from her. The two went from being disgusted with each other to being in love with each other, and started a new life together. A sweet romantic journey.

name: Ecuador: On the Wild Side
summary: Discover biotopes and endemic species that have evolved over millions of years, but are now at risk from deforestation and climate change.

previousepisode.name: From the Andes to the Galapagos Islands

name: Spring Flowers Are Blooming Chen Xiaozhu
summary: The innocent and cute "little pig demon" coveted the demon-catching treasure gourd of the demigod Feng Pan. He wanted to steal the treasure, but was forced to stay by the sinister and domineering Feng Pan. From then on, one god and one demon embarked on a journey of catching demons with laughter and tears.

name: Invisible Engine
summary: The sound of the vibrating engine hummed in the night, the broken car windows pierced the fog, and the dim yellow car lights illuminated the road ahead. Even though we were stuck in the mud, we still had hope.

name: Second Chance Romance
summary: Retired ballet artist Tan Siting returns to China, wanting to seek a second chance with Feng Rui, the lover she was once forced to leave behind. But past misunderstandings have built a wall between them. Feng Rui's orderly life as a a single father is thrown into chaos by her reappearance. Meanwhile, Tan Siting is accompanied by a man who has loved her from afar for a decade. As Tan Siting and Feng Rui try to avoid each other, fate keeps forcing them together, leaving them trapped in a turbulent mix of love and heartache.

name: Kill My Sins
summary: The wandering physician Ye Ping An, entangled in an old and secretive case, arrives in Chang'an. Accused of mystical medical interventions, she manipulates minds and evokes fear, while the low-born magistrate Yuan Shao Cheng, craving power, seizes the opportunity to rise. A murder in Chang'an implicates Ye Ping An, but is she truly an innocent scapegoat or a mastermind plotting revenge? The first move in her intricate scheme has already unraveled.

name: My Talent Neighbour
summary: Genius engineer Chen Xiao was introduced to a rival company by headhunter Shen Nuo, and was designed by his former partner Qi Jialun. After his mother passed away, he started his entrepreneurial journey with the company and encouragement of Shen Nuo, and finally broke the Western monopoly on artificial intelligence with his former brothers.

name: Inspire Me
summary: Wu Tong, as an elderly working mother who has to do everything well, slowly adapted to the adjustment with the understanding and support of her husband Hu Yichuan. In the postpartum confinement center, Wu Tong met the perfect mother Song Bingxue and her writer husband Tang Mucheng, the post-00s "bottom" hot mom Li Lu, single parent celebrity mother Jin Yutong and others. Faced with postpartum difficulties, mothers understand and encourage each other, and break through and grow together on the road of parenting.

name: The Legendary Chitose-Sama
summary: Lady Jun Qinglan's family is wiped out in a massacre. Her former fiancé, Li Congyao, not only refuses to help but personally disfigures her. She barely escapes with her life, changes her identity, disguises herself as a man, and becomes a coroner at the Dali Temple — biding her time, waiting for the chance to seek justice and revenge. But when she crosses paths with Li Congyao again, the man she once loved has become a ruthless and cruel prince, who forcibly takes her and holds her captive. Caught between love and hatred, intrigue and betrayal, layers of old mysteries begin to surface — and a deadly game of vengeance and desire begins anew.

name: Players
summary: Set in the future, a group of young people get caught up in a mysterious AI controlled game.

name: Love Under the Floral Rain
summary: The story revolves around the romance of Hua Zhuyu, who disguises as a male to enter the battlefield; and Feng Junli, the prime minister of South Dynasty

name: Arjen
summary: Arjen, one of the world's most dangerous assassins, is tested with his conscience in his last mission

name: Дурнушек.net
summary: The appearance of the program participants does not allow them to establish a personal life, and those around them do not take them seriously. Project stylist Sasha Podielskaya will select a stylish and feminine wardrobe for the girls, and makeup artists will teach how to take care of their hair and do the right makeup.

name: Перезагрузка
summary: "Reboot" is a show of incredible transformations. The participants in the project are ordinary girls who find themselves in a difficult situation. They have different stories, but they all have one thing in common: "Reboot" is the first step towards a new happy life. The main goal of the show is not only external transformation, but also internal transformation, behind which lies the painstaking work of specialists. Presenter Ksenia Borodina and her team will prove to the project participants that they deserve the best. Psychologists, fitness trainers, plastic surgeons, stylists, cosmetologists and makeup artists work with the girls for a whole month.

name: Sueltos en Los Cabos
summary: Eight hot, young singles arrive to an amazing villa in Los Cabos, San Lucas for the vacation of a lifetime.

name: Comedy Class par Éric & Ramzy
summary: In the first season of Comedy Class, Eric and Ramzy go in search of new comedy talent in Paris, Nantes, Marseille, and Brussels. Throughout the Comedy Class adventure, the mentors are joined by special guests.

name: Зонтик для подруг
summary:
Asya, Lera and Nadya are best friends since school. Each of them has their own well-established life, but relationships with men do not work out. After 20 years of marriage, Nadya's husband left for his pregnant secretary. Lera got married right after school and gave birth to a child, but she has been raising her son on her own for a long time. Her lover Kostya is married and has no intention of leaving the family. Asya has never been married and has no children. With the appearance of Igor in her life, everyone thinks that they are a wonderful couple. But Igor doesn't think so.
Tired of eternal problems with men, the friends take an oath to each other that from now on there will be no traitors in their lives. Girls no longer believe in relationships and will not allow men to ruin their lives. But even the strongest vows lose their power when true love comes...

name: #Даняизвини
summary: The young and successful musician Danya - Sorry - encountered difficulties communicating with girls. He feels awkward and unsure of himself and needs help learning how to communicate properly with the opposite sex.

name: Племя
summary: "Tribe" is a Russian reality show on the "Friday!" channel, in which the stars of domestic show business will have to survive alone with a wild tribe.

name: Зов крови
summary: The heroes of the "Call of Blood" project grew up in single-parent families and were raised in orphanages. But they did not lose hope of finding answers to the damned questions about the mystery of their birth. Participants in "Call of Blood" go in search of the people closest to them – their mothers or fathers. They are ready to travel kilometers for the sake of their goal. This journey is the main thing in their lives. Because there is nothing stronger than the call of blood.

name: Smartypants
summary: The greatest thinkers/comedians of our time ask the questions no one else will.

name: Anti-Hero
summary: Japan has a conviction rate of 99.9% for criminal cases that goes to trial. A lawyer is able to defeat those odds and obtain an acquittal for his client, even though there's conclusive evidence that says otherwise. Sometimes, due to minor things, good and evil can switch sides and good people can become bad people.

name: Inside Politics
summary: Inside Politics is a political talk show, broadcast on CNN. Originally hosted by Catherine Crier and Bernard Shaw, and then Shaw and Judy Woodruff, the show ran from 1992 to 2005 before being cancelled.

name: Narrow Escapes
summary: From bobbing businesses to continuous cruisers, we meet the vibrant community who call the UK's canal network home.

name: Jamie Cooks Spring
summary: Jamie Oliver takes us on a joyful journey of sumptuous spring flavours, as he re-awakens the kitchen garden after winter.

name: Gunslinger
summary: Adventures of Cord, a Civil War veteran working undercover for the Army.

name: The Great Pei
summary: It revolves around two youths of the Qian Hu Troops with contrasting personalities, who work together to solve cases.

name: Hard Noble Lady
summary: The young and successful CEO Liu Xi is a capitalist at work and a playboy in his personal life. He often belittles women, causing much distress and harm to the women around him, yet remains unaware of his behavior. One day, an unexpected accident occurs, and Liu Xi's soul is transported into the strict household of a marquis, where he becomes Liu Xizhao, a young lady who is bullied by various forces within the household due to her high-status marriage. Liu Xizhao's husband is Lu Shaoyang, the frivolous fourth son of the Changping Marquis household. When Liu Xizhao, with his modern scoundrel mindset, clashes with the ancient playboy Lu Shaoyang, the two are completely incompatible. Liu Xizhao shocks Lu Shaoyang with his bold and unconventional actions. Before Liu Xizhao can adjust to his new identity, his mother-in-law drags him off to learn the household rules. Unable to accept the constraints of traditional female roles, he becomes desperate to escape. In his eagerness to return, Liu Xizhao defies the marquis household's rules, leading to his house arrest. Trapped in the back courtyard, Liu Xizhao is forced to endure the oppressive patriarchal customs and begins to understand the difficulties of being a woman. He is judged by traditional moral standards, finally grasping what it means to be indoctrinated and morally constrained. To protect his friends and himself from harm, Liu Xizhao embarks on a journey of leveling up and battling adversaries. He becomes proficient in the intricacies of household scheming, power struggles, and business warfare. Armed with his unique worldview and modern business acumen, he blazes an unstoppable path to victory.

name: Gordon the Garden Gnome
summary: Gordon is a cheerful fellow who has lots of fun taking care of all the plants and animals in his garden.

name: LipDub
summary: Good luck, and don't f*ck it up! Watch your favorite RuPaul's Drag Race lip-syncs with an exciting and hilarious twist - no music?! Relive these HER-storic lip-sync battles, as your favorite queens click heels, crack bones, and create chaos in this gag-worthy re-dub of RuPaul's Drag Race's most iconic performances.

previousepisode.name: All Stars 3 - Kennedy Davenport, Shangela, BeBe Zahara Benet, and Trixie Mattel

name: Night Fever
summary: Join James St. James and co-hosts Fenton Bailey and Randy Barbato as they talk to the leading New York nightlife figures of the 1970s, '80s, '90s, and beyond. Featured guests include Dianne Brill, Michael Musto, Peter Gatien, Lisa Edelstein, Moby, and Joey Arias among others. It's campy, it's gossipy, it's jaw-droppingly funny...definitely must-hear podcasting.

name: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
summary: Mike and Elvis are going global! This time, the stakes are higher, the deadlines tighter and the motor transformations are more jaw-dropping than ever.

name: The Killer Bride
summary: The amnesiac girl killer Yueyao finally faced her first killing mission at the age of sixteen. Yueyao was ordered by her master to assassinate the "cruel" General He Yunxing of the Fourteenth Yamen. Yueyao failed to sneak into the general's mansion to assassinate her, and was tricked by He Yunxing into becoming his newly married bride!

name: Peace in Palace, Peace in Chang'an
summary: The series is set in the late Tang dynasty of China. Li Shimin played a pivotal role in the battles leading up to the collapse of the Sui Dynasty, yet his father and founding Emperor Li Yuan, instead created his eldest son Li Jiancheng as the crown prince. The brothers' relationship quickly deteriorated, and Li Shimin ambushed and killed Li Jiancheng and younger brother Li Yuanji at Xuanwu Gate in 626. Wei Zheng served as advisor to Li Jiancheng during the princes' contention for power, yet was pardoned and later promoted to the position of left (senior) chancellor after impressing Li Shimin with his honest advice and constructive criticism. He works together with Li Shimin to create a flourishing Chang'an.

name: Sandstorm
summary: An old body-burning case is reopened, and Officer Chen Jianghe is urgently called back to his small town. Upon returning, he's swept into chaos—schemers, a lying killer, and revenge-driven victims, all closing in like a raging sandstorm. Yet, Chen believes every storm ends, and justice will prevail once the dust settles.

name: Anonymous Signal
summary: Former friends Kwok Pak Fei, Keung Hei Man, and Lau Lik reunite years after a botched operation led to a tragic death and estrangement. Now, a gruesome murder case tied to a human trafficking ring forces them to work together. As they investigate, mysterious messages appear with clues about the crimes, hinting at knowledge from the future. Together, they form a special unit, ASIB, to decode these messages and solve the chilling case.

name: Fight for Beauty
summary: Rival plastic surgeons Qiao Yang and Zhou Jingwen, trained under the same mentor, find themselves brought together by fate at their most vulnerable moments. As the leading doctors at their respective cosmetic surgery clinics, they head their teams through intense debates and confrontations over beauty standards, women's roles in the workplace, and the true essence of a healer's compassion.But when a far greater threat looms, the two women put aside their differences and unite against the dangerous underworld of illegal cosmetic practices. In their fight to restore the dignity of their profession, they also rediscover a more...

name: The Enlightened Path Wang Yang Ming's Journey
Outback Crystal Hunters
summary:
In the unforgiving Australian Outback, a new generation of treasure hunters is risking it all in a new rush for riches.
In the hostile Australian Outback, five courageous crystal hunting teams confront extreme conditions, from scorching deserts to frigid underground mines, in a bid to unearth some of the world's rarest and breathtaking crystals.

Fuelled by celebrity endorsements and a four-trillion-dollar-a-year global wellness industry, the crystal trade is booming, and Australia has some of the most ancient & richest deposits on earth.

Outback Crystal Hunters are on a quest to uncover these geological marvels - from giant million-dollar Amethyst clusters to magical, colour-changing Zircons. All these impassioned crystal hunters are driven to unearth and showcase these ancient wonders to the world while hungry to secure a life-changing payday.

previousepisode.name: From the Pinnacle to the Pit

name: In the Name of Justice
summary: Set in the province of Haidong, the drama follows prosecutors Hong Liang and Zheng Yaping as they reopen the notorious "Wan Hai Organized-Crime Case" in Dongping City. During their review they uncover evidence that judicial insiders bent the law to shield the syndicate. Using a whistle-blower tip as their entry point, the team dismantles the criminal network and brings the corrupt officials behind it to justice.

name: The Legend of Sealed Book
summary: Hu Yong'er encountered a saintess by chance, and was taught magic skills from the heavenly sealed book. Sheuses the skills to help the poor, but was arrested by the government. Hu Yong'er has nowhere to escape, and could only run back to the saintess, who turned out to be the leader of the Tushan Sect and her birth mother. Hu Yong'er also discovers that the one who is pursuing her is her own elder brother, Zuo Mo, who betrayed Tushan Sect for his own selfish gains. Zuo Mo wants to capture Hu Yong'er to learn about the secret magic of he sealed book and revive the fox tribe. To save the world, Hu Yong'er, under the guidance of her mother, learned the magical arts of the skilled book and defeated the evil forces.

name: Su Ji
summary: In the early morning of a spring day in the capital city, Su Lili, the owner of Suji Coffin Shop, happened to rescue a young man named Mutou. However, no one knew that she was the daughter of a former prime minister from the previous dynasty, and he was the son of the current lord Linjiang. They fall in love with each other and live a peaceful life. However, Mutou, who carried a hidden identity, suddenly went missing. In this chaotic and wandering world, Su Lili's true identity was discovered by Qi Fengxiang. He was cunning and ruthless, determined to vie for power, and tried to keep her by his side, but his path of a king is destined to be lonely. Can he provide her a peaceful life, and can she give him boundless freedom? And what about Mutou, who once said, "If I can fly away, I will fly back"? Where did he ultimately "fly" to, and can he "fly" back?

name: Alyssa Raw
summary: If you thought you knew the Grande Dame Diva of the South, you've got another thing coming. The new series starring the Dancing Diva herself!

name: Andy Warhol: Interviews
summary: Dive deep into the uncut interviews from the 2000 docuseries "Andy Warhol: The Complete Picture", with new introductions by RuPaul's Drag Race Season 12 finalist Crystal Methyd.

name: Lemme Pick You Up
summary: Starring Ts Madison, as she drives special guests around Los Angeles.

name: Our Queer Life
summary: Our Queer Life is a series produced by documentarian Matt Cullen, that shines a light on the stories of people in the LGBTQ+ community that have walked an exceptional path in life. From a street hustler, to a gay Cowboy, to Ts Madison, to a queer ex-Jehovah's Witness, to a YouTube superstar, Our Queer Life shows how vast, complex, layered, unique, strong, and beautiful the queer community is.

name: Hearts Are Wild
summary: Hearts Are Wild centered on the guest and staff of Caesars Palace in Las Vegas.

name: House Hunters: Agents Gone Wild
summary: The House Hunters franchise is expanding to help buyers with their unique wish lists. Whether it be amazing water homes or the dream of working with a real estate agent that is downright wacky, the pressure is on to find the perfect home.

name: The Emerald Isles
summary:
From Rathlin in the north to Cape Clear in the south, the islands off the coast of Ireland have long been a source of inspiration and of myth. But they're home to a rich diversity of wildlife too – and a wide range of people.

In this series, Ardal O'Hanlon takes us on a fascinating journey, unearthing the history, observing the wildlife and meeting the islanders trying to live in harmony with their extraordinary environment.

name: 2.5 Dimensional Seduction
summary: Okumura is a second-year high school student who serves as the president and only member of his school's manga club. An otaku, he claims he has no interest in real girls due to his obsession with a fictional character named Liliel. Suddenly, a first-year student named Lilysa Amano, who is passionate about cosplay, joins the club. When he agrees to be her photographer, Okumura discovers her favorite character is also Liliel. As a result, he finds himself conflicted about the situation.

name: Duel of Shadows
summary: Young detective Han Zhengfei, in the pursuit of the true culprit over 15 days, endures great hardship, but he never wavers. His hair turns white overnight, yet he remains true to his original aspiration. Ultimately, he succeeds in capturing the criminal and finds the professional faith as a law enforcer.

name: У моего ребенка шестое чувство
summary: Some of the children know how to predict the future, some see the dead, some heal with their hands, they all have different abilities, but it is equally difficult for all of them to learn to live with them. Psychic Galina Bagirova will help both the children themselves and their parents understand the nature of the supernatural gift.

name: Beguinas
summary: Segovia, 1559. Lucía de Avellaneda celebrates her engagement party with the Marquis of Peñarrosa, a nobleman chosen by her brother. This marriage promises to reinforce the financial and social status of the family, but, in the middle of the celebration, the fiancée receives an unexpected letter from a woman who claims to be her mother and who claims her on her deathbed. Lucía shows up at the beguinage, where her mother has summoned her. In this place she lives with other women independently and outside the Church. The young woman opens up to a new world that will make her question everything she had known until now. And she, furthermore, will know love through a pure and uncontrollable, but forbidden, passion. She will risk everything for Telmo, a Jewish man who must hide his beliefs and his past.

name: Campus Cops
summary: The sophomoric escapades of young college security officers running amok at fictional Canfield University. Among those on patrol are best buddies Andy and Wayne, who seem to spend all their time chasing female students and breaking rules.

name: Not Only... But Also
summary: Not Only... But Also is a 1960s BBC comedy series starring Peter Cook and Dudley Moore.

name: Green Animal
summary: The three-part documentary series looks at plants in a completely new way: It puts flora and fauna on the same level and shows that plants are also capable of feeling desire and that they ensure their continued existence with sophisticated survival strategies.

name: Britain's Most Beautiful Road
summary: Showcases the delights of the North Coast 500 road, Scotland's most scenic route. The loop of over 830km running through the country's north Highlands.

name: The Two Ronnies Sketchbook
summary: The Two Ronnies made a final re-entrance, after 17 years apart, for this reunion show. 6 episodes, looking back at the highlights of the incredible 12 year run of the original, humbly titled "The Two Ronnies". The duo, now into their seventies, sit behind a desk and behind those famous glasses, to bring us the best clips from the show.

name: I Had Three Wives
summary: A private investigator leverages the skills of his three ex-wives to help solve cases.

name: Amanpour
summary: Amanpour is CNN International's flagship global affairs interview program hosted by Chief International Correspondent Christiane Amanpour.

name: The Guilty Innocent with Christopher Eccleston
summary:
The Guilty Innocent with Christopher Eccleston is a gripping new series that explores some of the biggest miscarriages of justice in history. Each meticulously researched episode will see EMMY award-winning actor Christopher Eccleston lead an in-depth contemporary investigation into some of the world's most infamous cases of wrongful convictions.

Using archive footage, talking head interviews with historical experts and reconstruction, each exciting close-ended episode will bring to life these fascinating stories and explore why and how the system got the wrong person and what it says about our world today.

name: MTV's Hip Hop POV
summary: The popularity of hip-hop is wholeheartedly acknowledged in this weekly late-night platform, which shines a spotlight on the culture's artists, celebrities and topics making headlines. It features no-holds-barred commentary and opinions from five of hip-hop's leading tastemakers -- radio personalities Charlamagne Tha God and Devi Dev, journalist Sowmya Krishnamurthy, record label executive Bu Thiam and DJ Amanda Seales -- exclusive artist interviews and insider access to the industry's biggest events. Also, each half-hour episode concludes with a performance by one of hip-hop's hottest artists.

name: Linus the Lionhearted
summary: The misadventures of Linus the Lionhearted, the gentle ruler of animals.

name: Yalan
summary: Melike, who survived in prison for 20 years for the sake of her daughter, fell into the middle of a big lie when she was released. All the injustices and evil done to her unravel in the face of Melike, who draws her strength from goodness and light

name: Happy's Place
summary: Happy's Place follows Bobbie who inherits her father's restaurant and is less than thrilled to discover that she has a new business partner in the half-sister she never knew she had.

name: Ida & Vegard: plan Baby
summary: Ida Fladen and Vegard Harm are both forever single, but they both want to have children of their own. They've come up with plan B: could having children together be a good idea? Now, they want to see if it could actually happen.

name: Spårtsløpet
summary: In this series the contestants are assigned hilarious and embarassing tasks. The team with the most points after the season are the winners of Spårtsløpet.

name: El Chapulín Colorado Animado
summary: El Chapulín Colorado Animado is a Mexican animated series based on the live-action show of the same name, originally created by Roberto Gómez Bolaños. The show is produced by Ánima Estudios, who also produced El Chavo Animado, another animated adaptation of one of Bolaños' works.

name: Sune och hans värld
summary: Tosh is a girl-crazy 9-year-old boy who lives in a small town with his rather eccentric family. He'll do *anything* to melt the heart of his latest crush...and this often gets him into terrible, terrible trouble.

name: La recrue
summary: At just 18 years old, Kevin Lorin has become a high-flying scammer, a potential Arsène Lupine. While the police intervene in one of his scams on the Basque coast, he gives up on fleeing and surrenders to everyone's surprise. This early retirement will take an unexpected turn when the commissioner recruits him for a very special infiltration into a homicide case. Following this "fun" experience, he will have only one idea in mind: to become a cop!

name: Our Welsh Chapel Dream
summary: Keith Brymer Jones and his partner Marj restore a 160-year-old derelict chapel in Pwllheli, on Wales' Llyn Peninsula, to turn it into a forever home with a working pottery studio for the community.

name: Drag Me to the Movies
summary: A star studded cast of queens from RuPaul's Drag Race parodies your favorite blockbuster hits, transforming the movies you love in a whole new gender bending way.

name: Best Bite Wins
summary: In celebration of entertaining, passing apps, and eating together, Best Bite Wins gamifies cocktail party culture, with professional chefs competing to present the best party food to hungry judges and clientele at real events from birthday parties to retirement celebrations and everything in between.

name: Isa Soares Tonight
summary: Drawing on Soares's experience in the field, Isa Soares Tonight will cover the most pressing global issues across politics, business and culture. The nightly program will bring together CNN's world-class journalists with top newsmakers and experts to help viewers navigate the complex events shaping our present and our future.
